faq.a: Most major search engines ignore the keywords tag today, but title and description tags remain important for rankings and click-through.
faq.q: Do keywords meta tags still matter?

faq.a: Use index, follow for normal pages. Choose noindex for pages you don't want in search results, like admin or thank-you pages.
faq.q: What robots value should I pick?

faq.a: Google typically truncates titles past ~60 characters and descriptions past ~160, so staying within those limits keeps your snippet looking clean.
faq.q: Why is there a character guide?

faq.q: What's the difference between og: tags and twitter: tags?

faq.q: Why doesn't my image show when I share?

faq.q: Does robots.txt hide pages from everyone?

faq.a: At the root of your domain, e.g. https://example.com/robots.txt — that's the only location crawlers check.
faq.q: Where do I upload the file?

faq.a: The asterisk applies the following rules to every crawler. Use a specific name like Googlebot to target just one.
faq.q: What does User-agent: * mean?

Optionally add your sitemap URL.
Copy or download robots.txt and place it at your domain root.

faq.a: 60–70 is plain, easy-to-understand English — a good target for general web content. Scores below 30 are very hard to read.
faq.q: What is a good Flesch Reading Ease score?

faq.a: It's the approximate US school grade needed to understand the text. Grade 8 means an average 13–14 year old could follow it.
faq.q: What does the grade level mean?

faq.a: A built-in algorithm counts vowel groups and adjusts for silent trailing 'e's. It's an estimate, accurate enough for scoring purposes.
faq.q: How are syllables counted?

howTo: Paste your article or paragraph into the text box.
Read the reading-ease score and grade level.

faq.q: Will Google always show my description?

faq.q: Does a higher position change the preview?

faq.a: Yes — times come from the IANA timezone database in your browser, which includes all DST rules.
faq.q: Does it adjust for daylight saving?

faq.a: No. Once the page loads, all time calculations happen locally on your device.
faq.q: Is an internet connection needed?

faq.a: Timezones span the international date line — Sydney and Tokyo can be a calendar day ahead of the Americas.
faq.q: Why do some cities show a different date?

faq.a: Browsers block audio until you interact with the page. Pressing Start counts as your permission to play sound.
faq.q: Why do I have to press Start for sound?

faq.q: How do I know which beat I'm on?

faq.q: Can I change tempo while it's running?

faq.a: On most laptops yes if the tab stays loaded; on phones the browser may pause background tabs, so test it on your device first.
faq.q: Does it work when my screen is off?

description: Pick any date to get its ISO-8601 week number, the week-numbering year, the day of the year and how many days remain. Weeks start on Monday per the ISO standard.

faq.a: A standard where weeks start Monday and week 1 is the week containing the first Thursday of the year — used widely in business and scheduling.
faq.q: What is an ISO week number?

faq.a: Around 1 January, a date can belong to the last week of the previous ISO year or the first week of the next one, depending on which week its Thursday falls in.
faq.q: Why is the ISO year different from the calendar year?

faq.a: 1 January is day 1, counting every day including 29 February in leap years.
faq.q: How is the day of year counted?

howTo: Pick any date with the date picker.
Read the ISO week number and day of year instantly.
Use the ISO year note for dates near 1 January.
name: Week Number Calculator
